title: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
author: Lewis Carroll
blurb: Alice falls down a rabbit hole into a world of talking rabbits, mad tea parties and a very shouty Queen.

title: Through the Looking-Glass
author: Lewis Carroll
blurb: Alice climbs through a mirror into a back-to-front world laid out like a giant chess game.

title: The Wonderful Wizard of Oz
author: L. Frank Baum
blurb: A cyclone carries Dorothy to Oz, where she follows the yellow brick road with a scarecrow, a tin man and a lion.

title: The Jungle Book
author: Rudyard Kipling
blurb: Mowgli is raised by wolves, taught by a bear and a panther, and hunted by the tiger Shere Khan.

title: Anne of Green Gables
author: L. M. Montgomery
blurb: A talkative red-haired orphan is sent to Green Gables by mistake — and turns the whole place upside down.

title: Black Beauty
author: Anna Sewell
blurb: A horse tells his own life story, from a green meadow to the busy streets of London.

title: The Wind in the Willows
author: Kenneth Grahame
blurb: Mole, Ratty, Badger and the hopeless show-off Toad muck about on the river bank.

title: Heidi
author: Johanna Spyri
blurb: A little girl is sent to live with her gruff grandfather high up in the Swiss Alps.

title: Little Women
author: Louisa May Alcott
blurb: Meg, Jo, Beth and Amy grow up together — putting on plays, falling out, and making do.

title: Grimms' Fairy Tales
author: Jacob and Wilhelm Grimm
blurb: Dozens of the old tales: golden birds, brave tailors, wicked queens and lucky youngest sons.

title: Andersen's Fairy Tales
author: Hans Christian Andersen
blurb: The Little Mermaid, The Ugly Duckling, The Snow Queen and more, by the great Danish storyteller.

title: The Happy Prince and Other Tales
author: Oscar Wilde
blurb: Five gentle, funny, slightly sad tales — a gold statue, a nightingale, a selfish giant.

title: The Adventures of Pinocchio
author: Carlo Collodi
blurb: A wooden puppet who tells whopping lies goes looking for trouble, and finds plenty.

title: The Prince and the Pauper
author: Mark Twain
blurb: A prince and a beggar boy who look identical swap places — and neither can convince anyone.
